name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor
description: Ultrasonic distance sensor module (HC-SR04): a TRIG pulse of at least 10 us starts a measurement; after the burst ECHO stays high for the sound's round trip, 58.24 us per centimetre at 20 C (the speed of sound follows the air's temperature), from 2 to 400 cm, else a 38 ms timeout. Distance and temperature are interactive inputs.

pins.name: TRIG
pins.doc: Trigger: a pulse of 10 us or more

burst_delay.doc: From TRIG's falling edge to ECHO rising: the eight 40 kHz cycles (200 us) and the module's start; modules vary

inputs.name: distance_cm
inputs.doc: Distance to the target in front

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.doc: Air temperature, which sets the speed of sound

functional.claims: A trigger of 10 us or more, measured from its falling edge; ECHO after burst_delay; the echo the sound's round trip 2 d / c with c = 331.3 + 0.606 T m/s; 2-400 cm, else the 38 ms timeout; triggers during a measurement ignored; no answer below 4.0 V.
